queries.compiledQueryString:
select
  wa_intensity_rank,
  occ8,
  soc_title,
  n_postings,
  pct_postings
from usajobs.CMP_USAJobsOccupationComparisons
where wa_id = '${inputs.usajobs_wa.value}'
  and wa_intensity_rank <= 50
order by wa_intensity_rank
